findings.issue: No ErrorBoundary anywhere in the tree; a server-function rejection (e.g. PokeAPI 500) during a client-side navigation propagates uncaught and leaves the route broken with no recovery UI.
findings.suggestion: Wrap props.children in an <ErrorBoundary> (with a fallback and retry) inside the root, or per route.

findings.issue: Expired cache entries are only removed every 500 writes (sweep(now)), so a burst of traffic can hold stale entries past their TTL, and with no further writes they linger indefinitely.
findings.suggestion: Sweep opportunistically: delete expired entries on each cache miss/write, or run the sweep on a timer.

findings.issue: The typesById map construction is duplicated verbatim from homeList (lines 160-172); the two copies will drift.
findings.suggestion: Extract a shared pokemonTypesById() helper next to allTypes().

findings.issue: If the user navigates back/forward while a search debounce timer is pending, the input's text is not resynced with the URL's q (the effect skips when a timer is set), leaving input and filter state desynced.
findings.suggestion: Clear and re-sync the text signal on any q change (flush the pending timer in the effect).

findings.issue: Every other route exports a route.preload for its query but the team page does not, so its data isn't preloaded on hover/intent — inconsistent with the rest of the app.
findings.suggestion: Add a route.preload that calls getTeamDetails for the current team cookie.

findings.issue: The array-valued-search-param handling duplicates index.tsx's first() helper in an ad-hoc inline form.
findings.suggestion: Move first() into app/src/lib/format.ts and use it in both routes.

findings.issue: Moves tables are not covered by the route's preload, so switching games or landing with ?game= incurs an extra round-trip that other route data avoids.
findings.suggestion: Include getPokemonMoves in route.preload (params.name + requested/default game) for consistent loading behaviour.

summary: This is a clean, current-idiom SolidStart v2 codebase that I would merge with only nits outstanding. Data loading, routing, 404 handling and the SSR-safe cookie-backed team store all follow the documented patterns exactly, and the feature change reuses the existing abstractions without contorting them. The only follow-ups are an ErrorBoundary, a cache-sweep tweak, and extracting two small duplicated helpers.
